Container.Name: garden-planner
Container.Overview: Self-hosted garden layout planner. Draw beds, place crops at real spacing, see a planting calendar from your frost dates, and plan together with live updates. Multiple user accounts; the first account created becomes the admin.

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: Database (garden.db) lives here. Back this folder up.

Config.Name: Allow self sign-up
Config.Description: true lets anyone who can reach the page create an account. The admin can change this later in the app.

Config.Name: Behind reverse proxy
Config.Description: Set true if you use Nginx Proxy Manager, SWAG or a Cloudflare tunnel.

Config.Name: HTTPS-only cookies
Config.Description: Set true if you only ever open it over https://
